youtube.title: What is ACT’s position on the under-16 social media Bill?
youtube.summary: “We’re against it. If you make it strong enough to stop motivated teenagers, then you’re probably going to make it strong enough that you take away adults privacy and freedom. I think it’s worth considering whether we should say smartphones (not dumb phones) are as harmful to kids as vaping, smoking or drinking”. RCR’s Tane Webster spoke with Deputy Prime Minister and ACT Leader David Seymour.

youtube.title: What is ACT's most important policy that you are committed to getting across the line?
youtube.summary: “Getting down the size of the Government. We’ve got 30 people in the head of the Government, we’ve got 43 departments, we’ve got massive crossovers. There’s 82 different portfolios. If we could get back to one minister, one budget, one department - down to 18 ministers, 19 departments - then everything else becomes possible because you’ve got clear lines of accountability”. RCR’s Tane Webster spoke with Deputy Prime Minister and ACT Leader David Seymour.
